mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of azithromycin and possesses immunostimulatory properties that could theoretically affect antibiotic efficacy; azithromycin carries QT prolongation risk which ginseng may potentiate through additive cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for prolonged QT interval and reduced antibiotic efficacy; consider ECG if patient has cardiac risk factors; counsel on timing separation if possible, though clinical significance remains uncertain.
